component.name: MA-TUI
component.summary: Terminal controller and local speaker for Music Assistant

description.p: MA-TUI is a terminal interface for Music Assistant: browse your library and providers, control playback, volume, grouping and queues across your networked speakers, and follow podcasts and audiobooks with resume points and played-episode tracking. It also registers the machine it runs on as a Sendspin speaker, so Music Assistant can send audio there directly, without a separate companion player process.

screenshot.caption: Player, speakers and music browser in a terminal

description.p: Add editable multi-track queue actions and direct queue clearing. Local playback accepts Music Assistant's cached stream-start audio burst with bounded memory and reports a real queue bound failure instead of reconnecting indefinitely. Add the MA-TUI application icon, compact audio file metadata and Omarchy palette support in the Flatpak.

Automatic recovery from local audio output stream failures, with bounded retries that preserve volume, mute and delay. Persistent failures remain visible, and diagnostics show output format, callback health and recovery counts. Fix unplayed-podcast tracking to report incomplete results instead of a silently partial list, and to refresh on progress changes from other clients. Default local startup volume to 50 percent. Declare RTKit as an optional Arch dependency.
Show the real reason a local audio stream failed instead of a generic message. Draw a rule between the player list and the queue. Drop the stale "(Flatpak Beta)" label from the desktop entry name.
Security update (rustls TLS fix) and README corrections.
